Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a single daily productivity task with its status and progression within the Consistency Lab application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Task entity.

title.description: The descriptive title or name of the task.

createdAt.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the task was originally created.

dueDate.description: The specific date (ISO 8601 format, YYYY-MM-DD) on which the task is currently due. This date is updated when a task is forwarded.

isCompleted.description: A boolean flag indicating whether the task has been marked as completed.

completionTimestamp.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the task was marked as completed. This property is null if the task is not yet completed.

forwardedCount.description: A numerical count indicating how many times this task has been moved to a future date because it was marked 'Not Done'.

definition.description: Stores individual productivity tasks for a specific user within Consistency Lab.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns these tasks.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific task.
